question: Which Plate defaults and public plugin contracts serve a product job, and which duplicate an adequate Plite owner?
method: best-api-review/history-v2; Task full execution; Redesign from First Principles; Plate Plugin Creator; Benchmark matched type/runtime proof; Maintain Workflow doctrine repair; Agent Native Reviewer closure audit
trigger: The user accepted the fully typed factory plan and authorized direct execution across Yjs, copied collaboration UI, public docs, release artifacts, doctrine, proof and ledger closeout.
requirements: Expose YjsPlugin as a concrete non-installable factory with only create, require and map; every create call must return a fresh complete nominal descriptor.
Keep native yjs(options) as the sole owner of the input-to-exact-descriptor relation so awareness, compaction and validator-derived cursor metadata remain conditional through Plate adaptation.
Reuse the existing Plate author-stage input, compatibility and result model for factory map instead of introducing a second composition language.
Let require refine one or more real input keys to non-nullish requirements at compile time and reject missing values at runtime.
Keep extend and terminal configure on created descriptors, with no name, plugin portal, extend or configure on the factory object itself.
Delete handwritten Plate and copied forwarding factories without compatibility aliases, migrate live callers and docs, and keep unrelated feature constructors out of scope.

Prove positive and negative inference, runtime boundaries, clean finite declarations, package exports, copied UI, DCE, bounded TypeScript cost, bounded construction cost, registry output and doctrine mirrors.
evidenceReuse: Reused the immediately preceding factory-mapping verdict, shared descriptor identity proof and collaboration lifetime proof for unchanged ancestry, namespace and cleanup laws. Rechecked the implemented private HKT carrier, Plate author-stage result reuse, clean Yjs declaration partition, direct and copied type fixtures, runtime factory guards, copied registry tests, package boundaries, generated registry and doctrine mirrors. Reconstructed the exact uncommitted local forwarding function and declaration captured before replacement for the matched benchmark; the artifact records that provenance limitation.
summary: Pursue is implemented and adopted. platejs/yjs/react exports a concrete YjsPlugin factory whose create(options) preserves native conditional APIs and validator-derived cursor data, whose require(key).map(stage) derives copied factories through the existing Plate author-stage model, and whose factory object cannot be installed or configured. Created descriptors remain ordinary fresh descriptors with extend and terminal configure. The handwritten Plate and copied factories are deleted, callers and docs use create, focused package and copied UI proof passes, clean declarations are finite, DCE succeeds, and measured type/runtime costs stay within every frozen budget.
alternatives: Delete the mapped factory and keep handwritten createYjsPlugin plus createCollaborationPlugin: rejected because it restores duplicated overload and capability ownership across Plate and copied UI.
Move construction inputs into configure or extend: rejected because either method would gain a second lifecycle job and require an incomplete non-installable plugin state.
Split document, presence and compaction into separate plugins: rejected because those capabilities share one Yjs namespace, admission, controller and cleanup lifetime.

Use a concrete non-installable factory with create, require and map over the existing author-stage model: selected and implemented because it removes both forwarding layers while preserving one complete descriptor boundary.
proofLimits: Focused Plite Yjs, Plate Yjs/Yjs React/React-core, permanent type-contract, copied registry, table caller, architecture-tooling, clean entrypoint declaration, runtime build, DCE, registry and doctrine proof passes. The package-wide Plate typecheck and declaration build stop in the unrelated changed SuggestionPlugin.tsx on TS2883/TS4023/TS7056; the website typecheck consequently stops at the missing packed platejs/dist/index.d.ts API-reference prerequisite. The clean Yjs declaration partition was rebuilt after deleting stale incremental output and contains no old factory.
